---
applyTo: "app/**/*.tsx,app/**/*.css"
---

# Frontend design guidance

- Ground the visual direction in AI Khan's actual business-operations context; make deliberate, cohesive choices rather than defaulting to a generic dashboard template.
- Use distinctive, readable typography with a clear type scale and restrained line lengths.
- Build a cohesive color palette and use color, alignment, spacing, and hierarchy to clarify meaning.
- Give each screen intentional spacing and a clear visual focal point; keep decoration purposeful.
- Use subtle motion only when it communicates an interaction or state change. Respect `prefers-reduced-motion`.
- Make layouts responsive and interactions accessible, including semantic controls, keyboard use, visible focus, and sufficient contrast.
